name: a resistor leg on a rail is pinned like a leg in a row
find: if step.act == wiring_steps.JOIN and step.anchor.seat().kind == wiring_steps.ROW:

name: a resistor leg on a rail runs no jumper
find: JOIN, end, anchor, needs_jumper(end) or on_rail, role)

name: a resistor leg on a rail is said to go in the rail
a rail leg's own hole drops out of its step's holes
a resistor covers no hole between its legs
a rail leg is recorded as a jumper, so an added one never says to put the leg in
find: kind = (RAIL_LEG if resistor else JUMPER) if one.jumper else LEG
replace: kind = JUMPER if one.jumper else LEG

name: a leg in a free row before P953 is said to move its jumper
find: if new.kind == RAIL_LEG and old.kind == LEG and old.to == FREE_ROW:

name: a rail leg taken out leaves its jumper to the rail
find: if one.kind == RAIL_LEG:  # the leg goes

name: a moved rail leg's new jumper keeps the old step's color
find: color = new.color if new.kind == RAIL_LEG else old.color

name: a rail leg moved from a row is said to go in the rail
find: return "Move %s: %s (it went to %s)." % (change.name, self._rail_leg(jumper, after), change.before)
replace: return "Move %s: it now goes to %s (it went to %s)." % (change.name, after, change.before)

name: a rail leg bound for another rail is put in a new row, and its old jumper stays: a short
find: if old.kind == RAIL_LEG and new.kind == RAIL_LEG:

name: a rail leg bound for a row keeps its jumper to the old rail
a moved step's added or removed jumper is listed as a move
a moved rail leg's new color counts as a bench color
a moved rail leg's new jumper keeps a color the bench shows
find: if change.kind == RAIL_LEG and change.color in bench else change
